QuestInfo.name: Kerning City Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Nella of Kerning City is shivering from the cold. Of course she's cold! She's outside in this cold weather, meddling in everybody's business! Go see Nella.
QuestInfo.1: Nella of Kerning City says that she feels like she will freeze to death, and that her Heat Pack has gone cold. She begs you to get her a new one and tells you that the monsters wandering around Kerning City have been seen carrying Heat Packs.
QuestInfo.2: You got Heat Packs from the monsters and delivered them to Nella. She should be able to stay warm for a while now.

0.0: Ah, my hands are freezing. This winter is so cold. But I can't just stay home falling behind the times. I filled my pockets with Heat Packs and came outside. But now all my Heat Packs are! I really need to get some more Heat Packs, or else I'll become an icicle.  Can you help me?

yes.0: JM From tha Streetz told me that the monsters near Kerning City always carry Heat Packs. You think he lied? But I'm turning into an icicle out here... Would you go see if the monsters really have Heat Packs? If the monsters really carry #e#bHeat Packs#k#n, then would you bring me #e#b20#k#n?\n#b\n#i4032561# #t4032561# x 20

no.0: By tomorrow I'll be an ice sculpture. Gee, it's so cold.
